comments.title: Comments
public.headline: Come and make food people trust.
public.intro: We are a food manufacturer in Bắc Ninh with around five hundred people on the floor, in the warehouses and on the road. When we have a seat to fill, it is listed here — and the whole process, from your application to the day you start, runs in the open.
public.roles_failed: Could not load the open roles.
public.no_roles_hint: Nothing is being advertised today. Check back — this page is the first place a new role appears.
public.role_closed_hint: It is no longer taking applications. The open roles are on the home page.
public.step_apply: 1. You apply here — your details go straight into our system, and every application is read against the same written standard for this role.
public.step_test: 2. If your application meets that standard you are sent a short test built from this job description, not a generic one.
public.step_meet: 3. Pass the test and you meet a person, at {place}, for the offer.
public.footer: Kwook Việt Nam — Bắc Ninh. This page lists every role we are currently hiring for.
jobs.title: Hiring
jobs.subtitle: Post a role, set the bar, and publish it to the front page.
jobs.empty_hint: A posting starts as a draft you can edit freely. Publishing it freezes the terms and puts it on the front page.
jobs.all_hint: Drafts, live roles and closed ones, newest first.
jobs.bar_summary: Straight through at {auto} · considered from {min} · {cap} invited in total
jobs.publish_explain: It goes on the front page immediately, and its terms are frozen from that moment — you cannot change the description, the bar or the number of slots under people who have already applied. The closing date is when the pool is cut.
jobs.extend_explain: You can push a closing date back but never bring it forward — people were told they had until the original date.
jobs.summary_placeholder: The one sentence that appears on the card
jobs.description_placeholder: What the work is, what the day looks like, and what someone needs to be able to do.
jobs.description_hint: Write it properly — this is the text every application is measured against, so a vague description produces a vague standard.
jobs.the_bar_hint: Applications are scored out of 100 against this job description alone, never against each other, so arriving early is worth nothing. At or above the first number a candidate goes straight through. At or above the second they wait in the pool, and the remaining slots go to the top of it when applications close.
jobs.bar_order: The straight-through mark cannot be lower than the one below it.
jobs.not_yours: Hiring is not open to you
jobs.not_yours_hint: Only the Tổng Giám đốc and the sysadmin post roles. If you need a seat filled, ask the person you report to.
